name: @djgrant/freeagent/business-setup
description: Reads the FreeAgent business identity, accounting dates and basis, and UK VAT registration and initial return settings needed to audit account setup.

needs_auth.hint: Sign in to your FreeAgent account, then retry.

reads: FreeAgent business details, accounting dates and VAT registration settings

detect.needs_auth: $contains($string($details), 'Log in to your FreeAgent account') or $contains($string($dates), 'Log in to your FreeAgent account') or $contains($string($vatPage), 'Log in to your FreeAgent account')

resolve.map: ($d := $string($details); $a := $string($dates); $v := $string($vatPage); $val := function($tag) { $exists($tag) ? ($x := $match($string($tag), /value="([^"]*)"/).groups[0]; ($not($exists($x)) or $x = '') ? null : $x) : null }; $selected := function($block) { $exists($block) ? ($tag := $match($string($block), /<option[^>]*selected="selected"[^>]*>/).match; $val($tag)) : null }; $companyTypeBlock := $match($d, /<select[^>]*id="company_type"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/select>/).match; $companyType := $val($match($string($companyTypeBlock), /<option[^>]*>/).match); $companyNumber := $val($match($d, /<input[^>]*id="company_registration_number"[^>]*>/).match); $businessStart := $val($match($a, /<input[^>]*id="company_company_start_date"[^>]*>/).match); $tradingStart := $val($match($a, /<input[^>]*id="company_trading_start_date"[^>]*>/).match); $yearEnd := $val($match($a, /<input[^>]*id="company_first_accounting_year_end_date"[^>]*>/).match); $faStart := $val($match($a, /<input[^>]*id="company_freeagent_start_date"[^>]*>/).match); $accountingBasisBlock := $match($d & $a, /<select[^>]*id="[^"]*(?:accounting_basis|cash_basis)[^"]*"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/select>/).match; $accountingBasisRadio := $match($d & $a, /<input(?=[^>]*(?:id|name)="[^"]*(?:accounting_basis|cash_basis)[^"]*")(?=[^>]*checked="checked")[^>]*>/).match; $accountingBasis := $exists($accountingBasisBlock) ? $selected($accountingBasisBlock) : $val($accountingBasisRadio); $vatStatusTag := $match($v, /<input(?=[^>]*vat_registration_status)(?=[^>]*checked="checked")[^>]*>/).match; $vatStatus := $val($vatStatusTag); $vatNumber := $val($match($v, /<input[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_vat_registration_number"[^>]*>/).match); $vatEffective := $val($match($v, /<input[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_registration_effective_date"[^>]*>/).match); $vatDeregistered := $val($match($v, /<input[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_deregistration_effective_date"[^>]*>/).match); $vatFirstEnd := $val($match($v, /<input[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_first_return_period_ends_on"[^>]*>/).match); $frequency := $selected($match($v, /<select[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_default_period_length"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/select>/).match); $vatBasis := $selected($match($v, /<select[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_initial_basis"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/select>/).match); $frs := $val($match($v, /<input(?=[^>]*initially_on_frs)(?=[^>]*checked="checked")[^>]*>/).match); $nonStandard := $val($match($v, /<input(?=[^>]*ec_vat_reporting_enabled)(?=[^>]*checked="checked")[^>]*>/).match); $preReg := $selected($match($v, /<select[^>]*id="company_latest_vat_registration_attributes_default_pre_registration_period_in_months"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/select>/).match); {'business_type': $companyType, 'company_number': $companyNumber, 'business_start_date': $businessStart, 'trading_start_date': $tradingStart, 'accounting_year_end': $yearEnd, 'freeagent_start_date': $faStart, 'accounting_basis': $accountingBasis, 'vat': {'status': $vatStatus, 'registered': $vatStatus = 'Registered', 'registration_number': $vatNumber, 'registration_effective_date': $vatEffective, 'deregistration_effective_date': $vatDeregistered, 'first_return_period_end': $vatFirstEnd, 'return_frequency': $frequency, 'accounting_basis': $vatBasis, 'flat_rate_scheme': $frs = 'true' ? true : $frs = 'false' ? false : null, 'non_standard_rates_enabled': $nonStandard = 'true' ? true : $nonStandard = 'false' ? false : null, 'pre_registration_period_months': $preReg ? $number($preReg) : null}})
